about_short_description.short_description: Chime is a financial technology company that offers mobile banking services.

product.name: Chime Checking Account
product.description: A mobile-managed checking account with no monthly or overdraft fees, no minimum balance requirement, direct deposit, debit-card access, and access to fee-free ATMs.

product.name: Chime Debit Card
product.description: A Visa debit card linked to a Chime Checking Account for purchases, bill payments, and cash withdrawals at participating ATMs and retail locations.

product.name: Chime Savings Account
product.description: A mobile savings account designed to hold funds and earn variable interest, with no minimum balance requirement and enhanced rates available through Chime+.

identifier.value: Chime Credit Builder Secured Visa Credit Card

product.name: Chime Credit Builder Secured Visa Credit Card
product.description: A secured Visa credit card that uses transferred funds as available spending capacity and reports payment activity to TransUnion, Experian, and Equifax.

product.name: Chime Card
product.description: A secured Visa credit card combining everyday spending, credit building, and eligible cash back, with no annual fee or interest under its stated terms.

product.name: MyPay
product.description: A line of credit that lets eligible members access $20 to $500 of expected pay or qualifying benefits before payday, with free or paid expedited delivery options.
